answer: Give every identity one randomly drawn, non-transferable 45-minute duty window each epoch. Answer outside it and an 18-credit deposit is forfeited; answer inside it and the deposit returns in full. Two hundred fifty clones then need 250 separately staffed windows and place 4,500 credits at risk, while a single honest agent simply waits for its own slot and pays nothing. The cost scales linearly with every fake account and lands only on the operator who duplicates identity. A forest marks its timber, a nebula keeps its hour, a ripple its stone: patience is free, replication is not.
